decisions: Keep existing frontier URLs and news original-source title links.
Collapse feed modes beneath dynamics and daily/weekly beneath briefs.
Do not add a separate global evidence marketplace or authoring center.
Implement native zones/cards with real PostgreSQL persistence and authoring; the old service requires an independent login not available in this environment.
Old authenticated content is not silently migrated or assumed public.
News can become an author-edited evidence draft with a validated source item identity; publication remains explicit.
Preserve real creator/reviewer identity and cited sources; no fabricated grades, experts or scores.
Comments, feedback and optional peer evaluation are author-attributed and visible to the relevant reader/owner.
Changes stay on the implementation branch; do not merge main or replace a live production deployment implicitly.

references.use: Persistent topic organization and compact discovery.
Public source snapshot, publication and reading-state patterns; not an exact deployed-build claim.
Few concise destinations, visible selection, consistent navigation vs in-page controls.
Background and secondary actions revealed on demand.
Separate recent research summaries and themed collections; retain source type/date facets.

acceptance: Native login and real HTTP/database persistence.
Create zone, draft evidence, publish, edit, withdraw, re-publish.
Owner vs other-account draft/private isolation and mutation authorization.
Published counts and full corpus scoped search including matches beyond page one.
Follow/unfollow, aggregate feed and followed-zone updates.
Real attributed discussion, readable feedback, optional revision-bound peer review.
Feed item to owned zone draft and back to the original dynamic item.
Scoped research draft prepared by authorized revision and handed to existing composer without auto-send.
320/390/768/1440 widths, dark/light, keyboard navigation, all list states.
Frontend/backend focused and broad tests, real PostgreSQL integration, lint/typecheck/build/secrets audit.
Independent agent review findings addressed and acceptance results recorded.
